title: Stop the Plague Through Sacrificial Giving
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about the transformative power of sacrificial giving. Learn how surrendering your resources, time, and effort can break curses, stop plagues, and release unprecedented blessings into your life and the lives of your loved ones. In this message, Pastor Zehner reveals how David's willingness to pay the price for the threshing floor set him up for a lifetime of spiritual breakthroughs and generational blessing.
